name: openvault
description: Visible local plugin that routes bookmark and social favorites imports into the right Obsidian archive workflow under the openvault brand.

interface.shortDescription: 统一入口：书签库、小红书、B站、X Likes
interface.longDescription: 一个可见的本地插件，用 1 个总入口和 4 个专用入口复用现有资源归档 workflows，并统一到 openvault 品牌。
defaultPrompt: Use $archive-router to route a bookmarks HTML, Xiaohongshu export, Bilibili favorites, or X likes JSON import.
Use $archive-bilibili to export my Bilibili favorites into Obsidian.
Use $archive-bookmarks to import a bookmarks HTML archive into Obsidian.
